description: Returns a composite verdict — BUY SELL HOLD trade call with confidence and market regime — for one crypto or tokenized-stock perpetual futures. One asset only; whole-market scan: scan_trade_calls. Read-only: live exchange APIs, no orders. Verified track record: get_track_record or performance://signal-performance; on-chain verified merkle anchor. [ALIAS] This tool is an alias of get_trade_call — same behavior, kept for backward compatibility. Prefer get_trade_call for new integrations.

assetClass.description: Force engine: 'perp' or 'equity'. Cross-venue multi-exchange AI trading signal.

coin.description: Base asset, e.g. BTC ETH SOL signal, or a US stock/ETF ticker (no USDT).

exchange.description: Crypto venue (default Binance), e.g. Binance Bybit OKX Bitget Hyperliquid.

includeReasoning.description: Include reasoning: trend ranging crypto signal and market regime drivers.

timeframe.description: Candle timeframe, 1m to 1d. Default 15m. Crypto quant intraday horizon.

name: get_trade_signal
